payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison between single-system and system combination approaches in terms of word error rate (WER) performance and training efficiency.

claims.text: The single-system approach achieved a WER of 41.6% on the DEV set and 43.2% on the EVAL set, which is a significant improvement over previous single-system results without system combination.
Single-system methods can achieve competitive performance with less training data compared to system combination methods, which often require larger datasets for similar results.
The single-system approach demonstrated a relative WER reduction of 8% compared to the best previous results without system combination.
